correctness.rationale: The star radial reduction is exactly the eigenvalue of a positive 2×2 matrix derived from K_f=xi f/(1+f)(sI+fL)^-1 A. The substitution r=sqrt(m(s+f)/(s+mf)) is a strict decreasing bijection (0,infty)→(1,sqrt m), and symbolic differentiation gives a sign proportional to s(m-r^2)^2-m(m+r^2)(r+1)^2. The associated critical curve S_m(r) strictly increases from 4m(m+1)/(m-1)^2 to infinity. The exact witness m=16,s=20,f*=5 gives 1/9 versus 8/85 at infinity. The positive left Perron vector proves extinction at and below the threshold; monotone sub/supersolutions give a positive state above it. A checked full 17×17 exact-rational Perron certificate and 500 numerical spectra support the algebra; exhaustive proof is analytical.

value.rationale: A mobility-only reentrant deterministic persistence window is structurally motivated by the tension between mortality during exploration and connectivity mediated by a star hub. The explicit threshold links hub degree with explorer mortality and fully classifies whether capacity is monotone or unimodal for all star sizes. An exact 17-habitat witness demonstrates two qualitative state changes under a single scalar environmental intervention, rather than a minor spectral gain. The prior positive-mortality model supports ecological interpretation; no universal real-world field claims are made.
